data.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 14
data.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
data.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine
data.conditionImmunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The helmed horror has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Spell Immunity
traits.description: The helmed horror is immune to three spells chosen by its creator. Typical immunities include fireball, heat metal, and lightning bolt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The helmed horror makes two longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.
